plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District (Pending Cases)
plan.subtitle: Shows the number of pending scholarship applications per district and scheme.

panels.title: Pending Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pending_count DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Districts with Most Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pending_count DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Pending Applications by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pending_count DESC

panels.title: Distribution of Pending Status Across Categories
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pending_count DESC

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides an overview of scholarship scheme progress, focusing on pending cases. Panel p1 displays a bar chart of pending applications by district, highlighting which districts have the highest backlog. Panel p2 lists the top five districts with the most pending applications, offering a quick reference for targeted interventions. Panel p3 breaks down pending applications by scholarship scheme, allowing administrators to identify which programs require immediate attention. Finally, panel p4 presents a pie chart showing the distribution of pending applications across different applicant categories, helping to understand demographic aspects of the backlog. All numeric values are represented using placeholders such as {{p1}} for the first numeric cell in each panel, ensuring the narrative remains flexible and data-driven.
